1.why: All six screens are static cards with no animations, carousels, or pop-up dialogs; the only dynamic element is a plain text log panel.

2.why: Each screen has a bold dark heading, a highlighted blue info callout, and a single high-contrast blue primary button, so the key item stands out, though the 'Stay safe' side panel adds competing emphasis.

3.why: Every step presents exactly one labelled input and one action button with a 'Step X of 5' indicator, making the required action easy to locate quickly.

4.why: The flow requires remembering/carrying a long one-time token, a six-digit MFA code, and a four-part password rule (12–128 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol) across five separate steps.

5.why: No password manager hint, autofill affordance, 'remember me' checkbox, or show-password toggle appears on any screen, including the password creation step.

6.why: Nothing saved or familiar is shown back to her — the account contact field is blank with no masked hint, and codes must be re-read from a raw log panel rather than recognised.

7.why: Sentences are short, plain-language, and rendered in a legible sans-serif with good contrast and line spacing on every step.

8.why: No error or validation message is visible in any of the six screenshots, so the claim about helpful error text cannot be observed as true of this system.

9.why: No placeholder text or worked examples are given; the password rule is described verbally and 'Account contact' offers no sample format, only 'Six-digit security code' hints at length.

10.why: The system offers no alternative authentication choices at all — a single fixed token + password + MFA path is imposed, so there are no clear login options to compare.

11.why: Each screen exposes only one input and one primary action, so the user is never faced with multiple simultaneous choices.

12.why: Step numbering plus explicit confirmations ('Your account recovery is complete', 'Privacy statement accepted — Recovery and verification are complete') communicate outcomes, though intermediate success messages are not shown for each individual submit.

13.why: Every step includes a short blue tip callout explaining what to do, plus a persistent 'Stay safe' anti-phishing guidance panel.

14.why: Only step 2 offers a recovery path ('Need a new token? Return to recovery request'); the other steps show no back link, cancel, or retry control.

15.why: Header, two-column card layout, step label, info callout, button style, and footer text remain identical across all six screens.
